inputs.text: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed a bill on Thursday that requires new registered voters to prove that they are United States citizens in order to cast a ballot in state elections. In the press release, Senate Bill 175 was explained to only apply to state elections and only impacts new registrants.

output.main_topic: South Dakota law requiring new voters to prove U.S. citizenship to vote in state elections

central_relations.subject: Senate Bill 175
central_relations.object: new registered voters to prove that they are United States citizens in order to cast a ballot in state elections
